title: Prediction Market Betting Stretches Past Sports
summary: The rapid growth of prediction markets is raising questions about sports wagering, younger traders, market manipulation, and regulation. Sean Patrick Maloney, CEO and President of the Coalition for Prediction Markets, argues federally regulated platforms should be treated as financial markets overseen by a well-funded CFTC, rather than casinos. He joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the industry's safeguards, the controversy surrounding sports contracts, and why he expects prediction markets to expand further into politics and financial markets. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Eliud Kipchoge Takes His Running Mission Worldwide
summary: Eliud Kipchoge is taking the next chapter of his legendary marathon career around the world. The two-time Olympic marathon champion, who became the first person to run a marathon in under two hours, is embarking on a multi-year World Tour that will take him across all seven continents. Fresh off a victory and course record at the Melbourne Marathon, Kipchoge joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss his mission to inspire more people to run, the mental challenge of breaking the two-hour barrier, and the philosophy behind his mantra “No Human Is Limited.” He also discusses his decades-long partnership with Nike to help transform racing-shoe technology. (Source: Bloomberg)
